$comment: Written by hand. Scenario 10, the critic's switch (ADR-0010): one request, one proposal, and the runs that show each mode, each auto trigger, the model's ask taken and refused, the forced-off reviewer, the critic's tier, a resume, and on the agent capability the invocation held back for the critic. runs are played in order, one session each (the scripted server advances once per run): author names the author's script; session the run's critic members, cases the declared cases, tier the author's tier and criticReasoning the critic's (low and high are the capability's two tiers, tiers), breakAtAsk the run broken off once the model's ask is written, resumeFrom the run whose last checkpoint it continues, measure a row of the measurement. The critic checks the proposal with validate and says what the runtime said; the runtime answers validate valid and each rehearsal evaluated with the declared outcome.
